title: Check-in
description: Chase stations in person and collect their check-ins and badges.
summary: Go near a station and ask it for a check-in. Its answer is signed proof that it heard you, over which radio, where and when, and it hands you its badge. Your logbook counts every check-in over the years and shows your badges on a wall. Check-ins work over Bluetooth, WiFi and the local network, and over LoRa when you allow it, never over the internet. Run your own station: turn it on, choose a greeting and a badge, and announce events with a badge of their own.
